name: Juggler
ability: On your 1st day, publicly guess up to 5 players' characters. That night, you learn how many you got correct.
wakes: Only on the night after their first day, if they made guesses.
interaction: Day: publicly pairs up to 5 players with characters (repeats allowed). That night, the Storyteller shows the number of correct guesses with fingers.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned at night, may receive a false number. If drunk/poisoned while guessing but sober and healthy at night, gets the true count.

jinxes.text: If the Juggler guesses on their first day and dies by execution, tonight the living Cannibal learns how many guesses the Juggler got correct.

rulings.text: Learns the count that night unless they died before then.
0 to 5 guesses; players and characters may be repeated.
Drunk/poisoned while guessing but sober and healthy at night: true information.
'1st day' is the Juggler's own first day: a character who becomes the Juggler later guesses on their first day as Juggler (wiki example: Savant turned Juggler by Pit-Hag).
A guess is correct per the player's character, subject to registration (e.g. Recluse/Spy).

test_scenarios.name: two of three
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Juggler, Bob Imp, Carol Chef, Dan Baron.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Alice guesses Bob=Imp, Carol=Empath, Dan=Baron. Night 2.

test_scenarios.name: no guesses
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Alice makes no guesses. Night 2.

test_scenarios.name: juggler executed
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Juggler, Bob Imp, Carol Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Alice guesses Bob=Imp; Alice is executed.

test_scenarios.name: cannibal jinx
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Juggler, Bob Cannibal, Carol Imp, Dan Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Alice guesses Carol=Imp, Dan=Chef; Alice is executed. Night 2.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned at night
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Juggler, Bob Poisoner, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Alice guesses Carol=Imp, Bob=Poisoner. Night 2: Bob poisons Alice.
test_scenarios.expected: Storyteller may show a false count (e.g. 0); the true 2 is also legal.

test_scenarios.name: repeat guesses
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Alice guesses Bob=Imp twice. Night 2.
